ratings_why.fun: Dying and getting back up for the bow reads instantly and pays out every fight, and the four builds give real choices about who stands where and who dies last.
ratings_why.distinct: The core is familiar deathrattle-plus-reborn from Battlegrounds, but Understudy, selling as a death and Notices fed by other tribes' deaths are fresh.

verdict_why: Old Crest and the Wreath-Bearer Frog need clearer wording; the rest reads well and should stay as hot as it is.

points.text: Old Crest doesn't say whether a unit that died twice (Encore) is replayed once or twice, or whether the Prompter's Boy doubles the replays. Say both on the card.
"Without Encore Encore" makes the reader stop. Try "Death Scene: give Encore to a random other friendly unit that doesn't have it."
Little Anguis's dropped tail, the one that gets better notices than he does, is missing from his card. A small tail token left behind when he steps in would show that joke in play.
The Natterjack reads last fight's Notices, but the screen only shows the game total. Show last fight's count next to the total so a player can see the gold coming.
The bluff strike and the musk from the seed are unused. A mouth-shut bluff that only bites for real once would carry the adder's 'one real bite' in what a card does.

standouts.why: Sir Hesketh raising the whole cast when the last one falls is the troupe's fantasy in one line, and a moment players will remember.
Madame Coronella's farewell tour turns selling into a death scene; clear, funny and a real shop lever.
The critic who really does kill an actor reads at once and makes self-harm a deliberate, on-theme choice.

weakest.why: Bit-Part Lizard is a plain deathrattle buff any tribe could have.
Sand Lizard Bill-Poster is a generic counter-reader with no stage in what it does.
Toad Claque is a flat cheer-on buff; readable but forgettable.

flags.note: How many times each death is replayed, and whether the Prompter's Boy doubles it, isn't written.
Doubled word 'Encore Encore' reads like a typo.
Prompter's Boy with Encore, Old Crest and Sir Hesketh multiplies Death Scenes a lot; the designer already flags it for a sim.
